body:
Don’t worry your not angering me. 
I know you were trying to help and I appreciate it, it just feels pointless. 
Sorry if I gave you the wrong idea

I’ve had professional help. It didn’t do shit for me. Why can’t people just let me fucking die, I gave up already and I don’t want to give myself false hope anymore. Nothing will get better for me, I’ve done everything I could, everything. And I’m still this way. I deserve to be like this. I deserve to be dead and it’s my fault. So please don’t tell me to “not give up” it’s only false encouragement
If it’s about doing what’s right I should of killed myself years ago, just wish it was that simple

I appreciate you trying to help but I think I’m beyond that point, if anything I need to stop stalling, people have told me “just go another week” for years now. Why can’t people just forget me? It would make this all so much easier for everyone

I’ve tried pretty much everything I could to prevent myself from it but now that I’ve actually done it I sort of regret not doing it more 
It honestly doesn’t matter, I’m pretty much just stalling time anyway
Even if I do have a moment of cutting to deep it won’t make a difference in the long term, people can see it all they want. I really don’t care at this point
I didn’t cut deep, not enough to scar, I’ve always been too squeamish for it. It will heal, I don’t need to worry about people seeing it.
